primary_metric.value: realized value = max measured EQE / max EQE on the line (clipped at 0), per episode; comparison fm vs classical, paired per episode; inference at the element-cluster level (14 clusters, cluster means, t with df=13)

value: each agent arm vs the strongest mechanical floor (read from instrument/floors.csv)
each arm vs chance (exact expected best-of-5 random)

chance_baseline.value: bench/floors.py::chance, exact expectation under random allocation of 5 EQE without replacement

coverage_rule.value: a cell that crashed, timed out or measured zero EQE is a coverage failure, excluded from the pair and counted, never scored zero; realized value is computed from measured EQE whether or not submit was called

repair_budget.value: zero retries per cell (gate G2); a harness failure affecting all arms of an episode drops that episode from all arms and is reported

label_protocol.value: labels = EQE maps in Fig1c_allEQE_withcriteria.csv; opened by adjudication/score.py only after blind hashes are written (gate G3)

value: FM-arm FM-tool use (>=1 FM call vs none) -- descriptive only, it is post-treatment
if FM tools carry value, fm - classical > 0 and rises in episodes where the FM arm actually called FM tools
advantage should vanish in the low_signal stratum
depth prediction: advantage absent where the EQE-only floor already reaches 1.0

claim_rule.value: a directional claim only when the cluster-level 95% CI excludes 0 AND |effect| > MDE from supply/power_record.json; otherwise report no-claim with MDE

item_ledger.note: pilot items (r3_step1, r3_step2) are outside the arm cohort; no scored element changed in response to them, so none burned
